name: Eagan Peltskinner
label: Quest
description: Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner has work for recruits as timber wolves threaten the valley. The local furrier needs hunters to thin the packs…
intro: Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner has work for recruits as timber wolves threaten the valley. The local furrier needs hunters to thin the packs and bring back pelts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.
If you're interested then speak with Eagan. He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's true. I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! Are you that person?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
